status: Original local reconstruction; packaged visual review pending

observed_defect.cause: GLO-90 surface heights of roughly 14 m are blended toward the adjacent 5 m road, producing an unsupported street-side ramp. This is a scenery DSM artifact, not a racing-road elevation correction.

reconstruction.scope: Service street buffer clipped to driver RIGHT of native 2590–2850; all protected racing corridors, buildings, water and the exact Sabir Park polygon excluded. Real Court footprint is separately cut out of the DSM terrain; its facade and floor datum stay unchanged.
reconstruction.height: Linear grade between unchanged nearest racing-road heights at the two mapped service-street endpoints. Cubic fades rejoin original joined scenery ground at road, Park and outer boundaries.
reconstruction.surface_note: Mapped street is asphalt. Adjoining light hardscape and substructure ground are estimates from the supplied view, not surveyed paving extents. The wider transition preserves outer heights and does not assert a 42 m wide street.
reconstruction.unchanged: All native road XYZ, bank, asphalt widths, protection and physics. Sabir Park and Court facade heights are unchanged. No scenery ground value provider or global vertical datum is modified.

registration_caveat: The original 236 s reference is an earlier approach than the 2680 m game target. Continuous forward/rear frames establish frontage and slope context, not an exact camera match. Sabir Park is 27.8 m from the original ramp ray; the ramp itself is mapped service-street frontage, not Park.

source_proof.scope_note: Street-only numeric proof; Park surface and planting have a separate proof. All street triangle centroids are driver RIGHT. These are source proofs, not packaged visual acceptance.

Sabir_Park.planting_note: 49 original broadleaf positions jittered within the retained park planting area. Heights 8.5–12.5 m, approximately 8 m spacing are visual estimates from the dense-tree reference. Source ground is unchanged; canopy cannot intersect protected roads or buildings. No grass is placed on mapped paths, road corridors, building footprints or water.
